title: Stable registry project ids derived from project identity
description: WHY: cross-workspace reference URIs (sprint G3) are keyed by registry project id, and dangling-reference recovery requires that unlinking then relinking the same project restores the same id. Today ProjectRegistryEntry.id (packages/core/src/project-registry.ts lines 35-58) has no documented stability contract. WHAT: derive the id deterministically from durable project identity - prefer the project config identity recorded at bwrk install time (projectConfigPath contents) over filesystem path, with a documented fallback chain (config id, then git remote fingerprint, then normalized path hash) and a collision policy. Registry add and import-setup paths compute it the same way; relinking a previously archived entry reuses the archived entry rather than minting a new one. Write the contract into the design doc and cover with unit tests including move-the-repo and unlink-relink scenarios. Keep the registry schema version bump additive with migration for existing entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Unlink then relink of the same project yields the same project id, covered by tests
Moving a project directory and relinking preserves identity via the fallback chain, covered by tests
Existing registry files migrate without data loss
